AiPrise
AI-powered Global Compliance Platform
AiPrise is an AI-powered compliance platform for KYB, KYC and AML. Fintechs, payment companies, crypto and stablecoin platforms, and marketplaces use AiPrise to verify and onboard businesses and individuals in 200+ countries in minutes, not weeks. One API connects to 500+ government registries and data sources. AI agents review KYB cases, detect identity fraud, screen against sanctions and watchlists, read documents and check business websites. AiPrise is SOC 2 Type II compliant, backed by Y Combinator and Headline, and trusted by 150+ companies worldwide. Headquartered in San Jose, California.
